<script>
   (function(scope) {
    // 1. Initialize local states
    scope.btn1_local = undefined;
    scope.btn2_local = undefined;
    scope.btn3_local = undefined;

    // Store server states separately
    scope.server_state = { btn1: false, btn2: false, btn3: false };

    // 2. Watch for incoming server/polling state updates
    scope.$watch('msg', function(msg) {
      if (msg && msg.payload && typeof msg.payload === 'polling_inputs') {
        if (msg.payload.btn1 !== undefined) {
          scope.server_state.btn1 = msg.payload.btn1;
          scope.btn1_local = undefined; 
        }
        if (msg.payload.btn2 !== undefined) {
          scope.server_state.btn2 = msg.payload.btn2;
          scope.btn2_local = undefined;
        }
        if (msg.payload.btn3 !== undefined) {
          scope.server_state.btn3 = msg.payload.btn3;
          scope.btn3_local = undefined;
        }
      }
    });

    // 3. Bind Pointer Events safely after DOM render
    setTimeout(function() {
      const bindButton = function(elementId, localKey, payloadKey) {
        const btn = document.getElementById(elementId);
        if (!btn) return;

        // Pointer Down (Press start for mouse, touch, or pen)
        btn.addEventListener('pointerdown', function(e) {
          e.preventDefault(); // Stops mobile browser from stealing long-presses for scrolling/menus
          scope[localKey] = true;
          scope.send({ topic: 'supervision', payload: { [payloadKey]: true } });
          scope.$evalAsync(); // Safely updates Angular UI instantly
        });

        // Pointer Release / Exit (Press end)
        const pressEnd = function(e) {
          if (scope[localKey] === true) {
            scope[localKey] = false;
            scope.send({ topic: 'supervision', payload: { [payloadKey]: false } });
            scope.$evalAsync();
          }
        };

        btn.addEventListener('pointerup', pressEnd);
        btn.addEventListener('pointerleave', pressEnd);
        btn.addEventListener('pointercancel', pressEnd);
      };

      // Connect all 3 buttons
      bindButton('btn1-ellipse', 'btn1_local', 'svbtn1');
      bindButton('btn2-ellipse', 'btn2_local', 'svbtn2');
      bindButton('btn3-ellipse', 'btn3_local', 'svbtn3');
    }, 400);

  })(scope);
</script>
